forbidden_context: supplier confidential terms unless separately authorized
publication_rule: All applicable reviews must be ACCEPTED or NOT_APPLICABLE, any commercial claim must bind an immutable GMPC product/promotion snapshot, the asset must not be expired or revoked, and GMPC approval/audit evidence must exist.
revocation_rule: GMPC can revoke an asset at any time; revoked assets are not publishable even if prior review evidence remains valid.
invariants: Pomelli cannot create or alter price, promotion, discount, entitlement or budget authority.
Pomelli cannot become DIAL's campaign, asset, catalogue, identity or customer-data source of truth.
Provider-generated assets enter GMPC quarantine before review.
Provider availability and capability maturity are external-capability state; creative truth and lifecycle are GMPC state.
No production customer request depends on Pomelli availability.
No browser session token or cookie is persisted by DIAL.
staging_acceptance: manual Pomelli export ingested with immutable content hash
commercial claim refuses publication without snapshot binding
approved non-price asset can publish to staging only
audit/provenance evidence remains readable after revocation
